output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

## Step 1: Link each division (2015 base before 2010, 2023 base from 2010)

```{r}
cpi_long <- readRDS(here("data", "svar", "cpi_divisions_all_bases.rds"))

div_codes <- c("Хүнсний бараа, ундаа, ус"                     = "food",
               "Согтууруулах ундаа, тамхи"                    = "alcohol_tobacco",
               "Хувцас, бөс бараа, гутал"                     = "clothing",
               "Орон сууц, ус, цахилгаан, түлш"               = "housing_utilities",
               "Гэр ахуйн тавилга, гэр ахуйн бараа"           = "furnishings",
               "Эм тариа, эмнэлгийн үйлчилгээ"                = "health",
               "Тээвэр"                                       = "transport",
               "Холбооны хэрэгсэл, шуудангийн үйлчилгээ"      = "communication",
               "Амралт, чөлөөт цаг, соёлын бараа, үйлчилгээ"  = "recreation",
               "Боловсролын үйлчилгээ"                        = "education",
               "Зочид буудал, зоогийн газар, дотуур байр"     = "restaurants_hotels",
               "Даатгал, санхүүгийн үйлчилгээ"                = "insurance_finance",
               "Бусад бараа, үйлчилгээ"                       = "other")

divs <- cpi_long |>
  filter(base %in% c("2015", "2023"), division != "Ерөнхий индекс") |>
  mutate(code = unname(div_codes[division]),
         # in the 2015 base, "other goods and services" is mislabeled as insurance in the NSO export
         code = if_else(base == "2015" & code == "insurance_finance", "other", code)) |>
  filter(!is.na(code)) |>
  select(date, base, code, index) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = base, values_from = index, names_prefix = "b")

links <- divs |>
  filter(year(date) == 2010) |>
  group_by(code) |>
  summarise(link = sum(b2023) / sum(b2015), .groups = "drop")

div_linked <- divs |>
  left_join(links, by = "code") |>
  mutate(index = if_else(!is.na(b2023), b2023, b2015 * link)) |>
  filter(!is.na(index)) |>
  select(date, code, index)

div_linked |> group_by(code) |> summarise(first = min(date), last = max(date), n = n())
saveRDS(div_linked, here("data", "exclusion", "division_indices_linked_2006.rds"))
```

## Step 2: Ex-food back to 2006, using the official 2023 weights

```{r}
w_off <- c(food = 26.662467, alcohol_tobacco = 1.016744, clothing = 12.857192,
           housing_utilities = 9.511357, furnishings = 4.828691, health = 7.32321,
           transport = 16.71729, communication = 5.807952, recreation = 1.539559,
           education = 5.28623, restaurants_hotels = 2.409491, other = 5.605346) / 100

exfood_2006 <- div_linked |>
  filter(code %in% setdiff(names(w_off), "food")) |>
  mutate(wt = w_off[code]) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(index = sum(wt * index) / sum(wt), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(date) |>
  mutate(ex_food_yoy = 100 * (index / lag(index, 12) - 1))
table(exfood_2006$n)                                   # should be 11 every month

# check: from 2011 it should match the existing ex-food measure
readRDS(here("data", "exclusion", "exclusion_measures.rds")) |>
  select(date, old = ex_food_yoy) |>
  inner_join(select(exfood_2006, date, new = ex_food_yoy), by = "date") |>
  filter(!is.na(old)) |>
  summarise(max_gap = max(abs(old - new)))

saveRDS(exfood_2006, here("data", "exclusion", "exfood_linked_2006.rds"))
```
